card.line: Assyria was a powerful empire north of Babylonia along the Tigris River. Its kings attacked Israel and Judah, and it carried the Israelites away from their land.

moments.title: Ahab Asks Assyria for Help
moments.text: Under attack from Aram and Israel, King Ahaz sent silver and gold from the LORD's house to the king of Assyria. Assyria captured Damascus, and Ahaz went there to meet the Assyrian king.

moments.title: Hoshea Pays Assyria
moments.text: Shalmaneser king of Assyria attacked Hoshea, who became his vassal and paid tribute. Later Hoshea stopped paying and sent envoys to Egypt, so the king of Assyria put him in prison.

moments.title: Samaria Falls
moments.text: The king of Assyria besieged Samaria for three years and then captured it. He carried the Israelites away to Assyria and settled them in Halah, Gozan, and the cities of the Medes.

moments.title: Sennacherib Attacks Judah
moments.text: Sennacherib king of Assyria captured the fortified cities of Judah. Hezekiah sent him silver and gold, even stripping the gold from the temple doors, but Assyria still sent a great army to Jerusalem.

moments.title: Hezekiah Prays, Isaiah Answers
moments.text: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD about the Assyrian threat. Isaiah sent word that the LORD had heard his prayer concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria.
